post.description: Signs the admin in as another account ("login as") for at most one hour and sets the session cookie; the admin's own session ends. Recorded in the audit log. Admins cannot be impersonated (403); a disabled or unconfirmed account is a 409.
Confirms the email address with the token from the confirmation link and the account's password, and signs in. An unknown, used or expired link is a 410.
Ends an impersonation and signs the admin in again with a new session cookie. A 409 if the session is no impersonation.
Signs in with email and password and sets the session cookie. A wrong email or password is a 401; a correct password for an unconfirmed email is a 403.
Ends the session and clears the session cookie.

get.description: Returns the signed-in account, or 401 without a valid session. While an admin is signed in as the account, impersonator names the admin.

post.description: Creates a member account and mails a confirmation link to the email address. The answer is the same whether the address is new or already registered.

get.description: Returns the lessons that start in a range of school dates, as the caller may see them. Visitors who are not signed in see public lessons that are released, plus one-off lessons and special formats, which are published early. Members also see lessons for members, and regular lessons up to visibleUntil (early access). Staff see every lesson, hidden and unreleased ones included. Canceled lessons are included with their status.
